title: I Guess I Became the Mother of the Great Demon King's 10 Children in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sixteen-year-old Akari, still grieving the mother she lost in an accident, wishes for a family of her own and is summoned to another world as a priestess meant to bear ten children for the Demon King. She insists on conceiving through a magic potion, and her first daughter, An, hatches from an egg. The comedy follows Akari's mothering of the demon children and the emotionally distant king amid a war affecting demonkind.
life_message: Motherly love can heal grief and teach even the unloved to love.
